main.description: Lists a community's pending invitations (open and not lapsed), newest first. Only the community's owner and instance admins may list them; moderators and other accounts are refused. Not paginated: each invitee has at most one pending invitation per community.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is neither the community's owner nor an instance admin, or the community is not hosted here or is removed.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.
